name: es-social-contributions
description: Use this Guide to calculate Spanish social-security contributions for ordinary self-employed RETA workers and employers in the Régimen General in 2026. It covers annual computable income, the calendar-day monthly average, contribution bands, chosen and final bases, generic deductions, company and family floors, coverage rates, starting-fee conditions, bonuses, annual regularisation and pluriactividad refunds. For payroll it covers assessable remuneration, extra-pay proration, overtime, contribution groups, employer and employee shares, occupational tariffs, capped bases, MEI and solidarity, plus household salary bands and agricultural monthly, daily and inactivity methods. Trigger phrases include cuota de autónomos, RETA, cotización, TGSS, regularización, tarifa plana, Seguridad Social, RLC and payroll contributions.
